title: 12th South Cottage | Walk to Shops & Dining
description:
Stay in the heart of one of Nashville's most-loved neighborhoods.  Our charming 1930's bungalow is tucked into 12 South, just a short walk from restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques and local favorites.  Relax on the front porch, enjoy the private back yard and patio, or head downtown for a night out - then come home to a quiet neighborhood retreat.  With 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and room for up to 6 guests, it's a great home base for families, friends, and Nashville weekends.
